about: Public camera uplinks: webcams their operators publish for anyone to watch. NordicCiv lists where they are and links to the provider's public viewing page.

policy.include: Cameras intentionally published for public viewing on the operator's or a webcam publisher's public page, showing a place: settlements, mountains and valleys, fjords and coasts, islands, tourist destinations, ski resorts, weather observation, nature and viewpoints.
exclude: private, residential or exposed network cameras and unpublished endpoints
cameras aimed at people (shops, queues, courts, skateparks, street-level squares and parks)
vendor demonstrations, test and copy listings
golf courses, motorsport, airfields and construction sites
cameras whose owner does not say what they show
listings whose published position contradicts the place they name
duplicates of a camera already listed
pages served only over plain http
policy.positions: Published positions are used as published. Pages without coordinates are placed at the Wikidata coordinates of the place they show and marked as place positions.
policy.duplicates: One record per camera. Where the same camera is listed by several providers, the operator's own page is preferred, then the listing with a published position.
policy.status: Nothing here says a camera is live or working: that is only known on the provider's page.

camstreamer.name: CamStreamer
camstreamer.note: Streams published by the camera owners on CamStreamer's public gallery; position as published by the owner.

panomax.name: Panomax
panomax.note: Panoramic cameras run with the operators; position as published by Panomax.

webcamcollections.name: WebcamCollections
webcamcollections.note: Swedish webcam publisher; position as published on its public map.

skylinewebcams.name: SkylineWebcams
skylinewebcams.note: Webcam publisher; pages publish no coordinates (place position from Wikidata).

sources.places: Wikidata (CC0): coordinates of the place shown, for pages that publish none
sources.attribution: Camera names, positions and pages as published by CamStreamer and the camera owners, Panomax, WebcamCollections, SkylineWebcams and the operators named on each camera; place coordinates from Wikidata (CC0). Pictures belong to their publishers and are not reproduced here.
sources.reference: OSIRIS (github.com/simplifaisoul/osiris, MIT) was studied for camera discovery; none of its data is used (see docs/SOURCES.md).

meaning.status: Check the provider's page for the current camera status.
meaning.position: Published positions are where the provider puts the camera; place positions mark the place a page shows. The symbol marks a public viewpoint, not the camera's installation.
meaning.verified: Date the provider's public page last answered as a working page (not the camera stream).
meaning.absence: No uplink in a municipality means none was found or reviewed, not that none exists.
